goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A text-offer popup was announced first and its focus sat on the whole dialog, not a button. The decline button name contains an apostrophe and reads as a guilt-trip (No thanks, I will pay full price), and the jump had to use Dismiss this popup instead.

element.name: No thanks, I am pay full price

findings.problem: The cookie dialog appeared right after the first popup closed, so a second modal had to be handled before shopping. The page tree behind it was a very long dump with endless repeated star images and no clear reading order.

After opening the product, the page title was empty and the main area showed only empty list items and no product name, price or Add to Cart. I had to re-read the page to get the real content. A screen reader user would hear nothing useful and not know loading was happening.

Add to Cart changed to a disabled Adding... button and focus was dropped to the top of the page, with no announcement. Only after a manual re-read did I learn that an Item Added to Cart dialog had opened.

Colour and size controls are plain buttons with no pressed or selected state; the current choice is only found in a separate figure label. Colour names such as Tandem Stripe in Storm do not say which is chosen.
After View Cart the page had an empty main region and focus at the top; the cart content only appeared after another read, and the title was set but nothing told me the cart was loading.

A dialog saying the discount may be incorrect and to contact support opened over the cart. Its Close and Review Cart buttons could not take keyboard focus and Escape did not close it, so I could not dismiss it. The warning also made no sense for a single non-bundle item. The Checkout button behind it was still reachable by keyboard, so the dialog is not modal for focus.

Many extra floating widgets (Hold Up! Stop Right There, wishlist, Get it before it is gone alert, unnamed empty paragraphs, unnamed textbox ftr-tmp-input) sit after the footer with unclear purpose and create noise.
On arrival the page title was Checkout but the page was nearly empty (an empty main and an unnamed level 2 heading) with no loading message. The real form only appeared after a re-read.

The Email me with news and offers box is checked by default, and the Remember me block sits just above Pay now, so a user must watch for pre-ticked marketing choices. The Address field is a combobox with no hint that it gives suggestions.

findings.problem: A text-offer popup was announced first and its focus sat on the whole dialog, not a button. The decline button name contains an apostrophe and reads as a guilt-trip (No thanks, I will pay full price), and the jump had to use Dismiss this popup instead.

element.name: No thanks, I am pay full price

findings.problem: The cookie dialog appeared right after the first popup closed, so a second modal had to be handled before shopping. The page tree behind it was a very long dump with endless repeated star images and no clear reading order.

After opening the product, the page title was empty and the main area showed only empty list items and no product name, price or Add to Cart. I had to re-read the page to get the real content. A screen reader user would hear nothing useful and not know loading was happening.

Add to Cart changed to a disabled Adding... button and focus was dropped to the top of the page, with no announcement. Only after a manual re-read did I learn that an Item Added to Cart dialog had opened.

Colour and size controls are plain buttons with no pressed or selected state; the current choice is only found in a separate figure label. Colour names such as Tandem Stripe in Storm do not say which is chosen.
After View Cart the page had an empty main region and focus at the top; the cart content only appeared after another read, and the title was set but nothing told me the cart was loading.

A dialog saying the discount may be incorrect and to contact support opened over the cart. Its Close and Review Cart buttons could not take keyboard focus and Escape did not close it, so I could not dismiss it. The warning also made no sense for a single non-bundle item. The Checkout button behind it was still reachable by keyboard, so the dialog is not modal for focus.

Many extra floating widgets (Hold Up! Stop Right There, wishlist, Get it before it is gone alert, unnamed empty paragraphs, unnamed textbox ftr-tmp-input) sit after the footer with unclear purpose and create noise.
On arrival the page title was Checkout but the page was nearly empty (an empty main and an unnamed level 2 heading) with no loading message. The real form only appeared after a re-read.

The Email me with news and offers box is checked by default, and the Remember me block sits just above Pay now, so a user must watch for pre-ticked marketing choices. The Address field is a combobox with no hint that it gives suggestions.
